Java Developer 
 Location – Atlanta, GA 
 Duration – 24 month contract 
 Interview – 1 Skype Call 
 Need GC and USC 
 Top Skills: 
 1. 7+ years of experience with Java Development for complex applications in an enterprise environment with Spring MVC, Oracle, JBoss, Tomcat, JavaScript, Python and SDKs 
 2. Experience building Restful APIs from scratch
 3. We need someone with a security background. (ISAM "IBM Security Access Manager" formerly known as TAM "Tivoli Access Manager") 
 Job Description: 
 This person will be doing 100% new development on a next-gen, industry leading enterprise portal application.
 The MobileKey application provides an open-source, secure single-sign on capability to all other AT&T products and services (i.e. connected car, IoT, DirecTV)
 On a daily basis, they will be given use cases from the Security Architecture Team and asked to perform entirely new development in Java. This person will be developing new secure, single-sign on capabilities/portal for the rest of the enterprise. 
 This will be a true agile environment with daily stand-ups and two week iterations. 
 This is an agile, continuous integration environment. It will give this person experience working with jenkins/automation. 
 Current Technology Stack:
 Java, Weblogic (legacy app), Jboss., Tomcat. Spring MVC, RESTful API, Oracle (future will be postgress), Jenkins


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib @usmsystems(dot)com or call me on  703 468 0398.
